prompt.project_info: Create a formal marriage-registration portrait of two approved adults.
prompt.main_subject: Approved adult woman in a pure white elegant satin dress with modest shoulder coverage and pearl drop earrings, beside an approved adult man in a blue-black double-breasted suit, white shirt, blue-black tie with subtle dots, and neat side-parted hair.
prompt.composition_elements: Female left and slightly forward, male right and slightly behind with shoulders aligned, half-body crop from upper chest to head, dark red solid background, eye-level front view, even soft lighting.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Front soft light without harsh shadows, formal warm harmonious solemn registration-photo atmosphere, dark red, white, and dark blue palette.
prompt.technical_specs: 3:2 two-inch ID-photo style, sharp facial detail, centered symmetrical framing, realistic skin, clean solid background.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Formal 3:2 marriage-registration portrait of two approved adults against a rich even dark-red solid background. The approved adult woman stands on the left and slightly forward in a pure white elegant satin dress with modest shoulder coverage, long black hair, natural makeup, a gentle tooth-showing smile, and pearl drop earrings. The approved adult man stands on the right and slightly behind in a blue-black double-breasted suit, pure white shirt, blue-black tie with subtle small dots, neatly side-parted black hair, and a friendly smile. Keep outer shoulders aligned, crop from upper chest to top of head, use eye-level front shooting and soft even light without obvious shadows. Formal, warm, elegant, harmonious, and solemn.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, underage, childlike, strapless dress, exposed chest, altered identity, harsh shadows, busy background, logos, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, airbrushed, HDR look, watermark, extra fingers, deformed, public figure likeness.

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: Attach the required composition reference. Preserve two approved adults, left-right arrangement, red background, formal palette, facial identity, and even lighting; wardrobe may be replaced with equally formal opaque attire. No logo or typography is required.
